comments.raw_content: /* 실제 예수금 기준 한도와 비교하여 MIN */
/* 계좌정보갱신여부 & 예외발생여부가 모두 Y면 출금건수 update */
/* 원문 일부 변수명 혼재 -> 총합계에 반영만 유지 */

sql.raw_content:
EXEC SQL
        SELECT 'Y'
          INTO :H_tagy_yn
          FROM SUU_UUA_ACNT A
             , SUU_UUA_ACNT_FUNCTION B
         WHERE A.ACNT_ID = :H_iacnt_id
           AND A.ACNT_ID = B.ACNT_ID
           AND B.ACNT_FNCN_TYPE_CODE = 'FDVA'
        WITH UR;

sql.raw_content:
EXEC SQL
        UPDATE SME_MEG_FTRS_WTHD_BLNC
           SET WTHD_TOTL_SUM_AMNT = WTHD_TOTL_SUM_AMNT
         WHERE ACNT_ID      = :H_iacnt_id
           AND PSTN_UNIT_NO = :H_pstn_unit_no;

sql.raw_content:
EXEC SQL
        SELECT WTHD_TOTL_SUM_AMNT
             , DPSD_SBAN_AMNT
             , (PVDW_STLT_PREV_CASH_AMNT - TSDD_STLT_PREV_CASH_AMNT)
             , (PVDW_SBTT_SELL_AMNT      - TSDD_SBTT_SELL_AMNT)
             , CASH_UNCL_AMNT + ETC_RMNTL_SUM_AMNT
             , OFUNS_SBTT_RCNY_AMNT
          INTO :H_iwthd_totl_sum_amnt
             , :H_idpsd_sban_amnt
             , :H_lsttl_prev_cash_amnt
             , :H_lsbts_sell_samt
             , :H_oa_un_clam_samt
             , :H_ofuns_sbtt_rcny_amnt
          FROM SME_MEG_FTRS_WTHD_BLNC
         WHERE ACNT_ID      = :H_iacnt_id
           AND PSTN_UNIT_NO = :H_pstn_unit_no
         FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
         WITH UR;

sql.raw_content:

        UPDATE SME_MEG_FTRS_WTHD_BLNC
           SET WTDW_CONT = WTDW_CONT + 1
         WHERE ACNT_ID      = :H_iacnt_id
           AND PSTN_UNIT_NO = :H_pstn_unit_no;
